summary: Creates rows and columns of POP points in a plane, with optional slices for a 3D grid. Connectivity can emit triangles, quads, lines, line strips, point primitives, or points only, and the generator can output dimension metadata, normals, and texture coordinates.

key_params.name: surftype
key_params.note: Connectivity primitive type: none, points, lines, line strips, triangles, alternating triangles, or quads

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Use connected input POP bounds as the starting grid bounds

key_params.name: cols
key_params.note: Number of columns in X

key_params.name: rows
key_params.note: Number of rows in Y

key_params.name: slices
key_params.note: Number of slices in Z

key_params.name: uniquepoints
key_params.note: Create unique points per primitive vertex, losing original grid dimensions

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: 3D size of the generated grid

key_params.name: seed
key_params.note: Randomization seed for point placement

key_params.name: random
key_params.note: Randomizes point position within cells

key_params.name: randomsizefit
key_params.note: Scale randomized grid bounds relative to the unrandomized grid

key_params.name: line
key_params.note: Enable line or line-strip output along X, Y, and Z axes

key_params.name: plane
key_params.note: Enable triangle or quad planes in XY, YZ, and ZX orientations

key_params.name: anchoru
key_params.note: Anchor left, middle, or right side at X=0

key_params.name: anchorv
key_params.note: Anchor bottom, middle, or top side at Y=0

key_params.name: anchorw
key_params.note: Anchor back, middle, or front side at Z=0

key_params.name: t
key_params.note: Post-translate generated points

key_params.name: r
key_params.note: Post-rotate generated points in degrees

key_params.name: scale
key_params.note: Uniform post-scale for generated points

key_params.name: normal
key_params.note: Choose whether to create point, vertex, or primitive normals

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Choose whether to create point or vertex Tex coordinates

key_params.name: dimension
key_params.note: Control when row/column/slice dimension metadata is appended

common_gotchas: Use Append Dimension intentionally; downstream POP and GLSL logic can read dimension metadata like _Dim[].
Unique Points makes each primitive vertex use a unique point, but the original grid dimension is lost.
Randomize set to 1 gives one randomized point per cell, which is useful for stable point distributions.
